raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Business Analyst and transformation professional with 12+ years of experience across banking and financial services, with strong exposure to hedge fund operations, fund reconciliations, investment banking, trade processing, FX settlements, client onboarding, process transformation and application modernization.. Experienced in requirements elicitation, business process analysis, AS-IS / TO-BE modelling, gap and impact analysis, functional documentation, stakeholder management, Agile delivery, UAT and production validation. Proven ability to bridge business, operations, product and technology teams to translate business needs into practical system and process solutions.
raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES
Business Analysis & Requirements Management • AS-IS / TO-BE Process Analysis & Process Mapping • Gap Analysis, Impact Analysis & Dependency Assessment • BRD, FRD, Functional Specifications, User Stories & Acceptance Criteria • Stakeholder Workshops & Cross-Functional Collaboration • Business Process Re-engineering & Process Automation • Investment Banking & Financial Services • FX Settlements, Trade Processing & Reconciliations • Client Onboarding & Operations Transformation • Hedge Fund Operations & Fund Reconciliations • Fund Operations & Investment Operations • Fund / Client Onboarding & Transitions • SWIFT / Payment-related Messaging Exposure • API & Application Integration Analysis • SIT, UAT, Production Validation & Defect Management • Agile / Scrum / SDLC • JIRA, SQL, IntelliMatch & Process Mapping
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
STATE STREET CORPORATE SERVICES MUMBAI PVT LTD. — Senior Manager | Aug 2018 – Sep 2025
Led business analysis activities across investment banking and hedge fund operations transformation and digital modernization initiatives.
Partnered with Front Office, Middle Office, Operations, Technology and Product teams to translate business objectives into functional and technical solutions.
Facilitated stakeholder workshops for requirements gathering, business process analysis, solution discovery and validation.
Prepared BRDs, FRDs, functional specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria for enterprise applications. • Performed AS-IS / TO-BE analysis, gap analysis, impact analysis and dependency assessment to support process and system transformation.
Analysed end-to-end business and system workflows, data flows, APIs and application integrations; defined business rules, functional requirements and process specifications to support technology delivery.
Collaborated with Solution Architects, Developers, QA and Product Owners throughout the SDLC. • Led sprint planning, backlog grooming, estimation and Agile ceremonies; coordinated SIT, UAT, production validation and defect management.
Performed business analysis for hedge fund operations and reconciliation workflows, analysing end-to-end transaction flows, operational exceptions, data dependencies and system impacts and translating findings into functional requirements and process improvements.
Shreedhar Rayala | Senior Business Analyst | Banking & Financial Services
• Supported hedge fund/client onboarding and transition activities, analysing operational requirements, process
dependencies and data requirements across business and technology teams.
Analysed hedge fund/client onboarding and transition requirements, mapping operational processes, data dependencies and system impacts across business and technology teams.
Drove process improvements using data analysis, KPIs, dashboards and reporting, while supporting regulatory, compliance, audit and governance initiatives.
Owned the end-to-end Product Ownership for a Fixed Income transformation project, driving requirements, stakeholder engagement, backlog prioritization, Agile delivery, UAT, and migration from Caliber to Geneva, while supporting FX, Equity, and Fixed Income products for 250+ global clients.
Key initiatives included decommissioning inactive client administration and trade files, migration of a Middle Office legacy system to Geneva, and creation of a new vendor billing procedure.
COGNIZANT TECHNOLOGY SOLUTIONS — Team Manager | Aug 2014 – Jul 2018
Led a 16-member L2 support team for US clients, maintaining 98% SLA adherence while driving UAT, change management and application improvements.
Delivered automation and system enhancements, including RPA implementation and trade-capture optimization, reducing manual effort and operational cost.
Configured SFTP / SWIFT connectivity for 40+ clients and supported dormant-account deactivation to strengthen application security.
Led UAT and collaborated with client IT teams to optimize trade-capture settings and reduce processing errors. • Managed change requests in JIRA and coordinated with development teams to improve application efficiency.
TATA CONSULTANCY SERVICES LTD. — Assistant Manager | Aug 2013 – Aug 2014
Supervised a 20-member L2 support team and improved IntelliMatch auto-matching through rule configuration. • Used SQL to troubleshoot file uploads and monitor automated jobs, reducing processing errors. • Conducted UAT and manual reconciliation to validate high-volume transaction processing. • Streamlined job scheduling in IntelliMatch Admin to reduce processing delays. • Supported migration and ongoing monitoring of the IntelliMatch application, with responsibility for stakeholder management.
SAXO IT INDIA — Team Leader | Dec 2010 – Aug 2013
Managed reconciliations for 25 NOSTRO accounts and equity positions, achieving 99% accuracy in coordination with prime brokers.
Migrated equity and cash reconciliation activities from Excel to IntelliMatch, improving operational efficiency. • Trained team members on FX and precious-metal trade verification and supported reduction of trade-booking errors. • Identified process improvement opportunities and presented recommendations to onshore management. • Led initiatives covering new equity reconciliation processes, auto-matching rules and cash-reconciliation efficiency.
COGNIZANT TECHNOLOGY SERVICES — Process Specialist | Oct 2007 – Oct 2010
Developed SOPs and process maps for prime brokerage processes to improve operational clarity. • Reconciled inter-system breaks for FX, equity options and cash trades and resolved issues within currency cut-off times. • Collaborated with Middle Office and trade-support teams to resolve client queries. • Processed non-STP FX trades through SWIFT confirmations, supporting reduction of discrepancies.
HCL TECHNOLOGIES LTD. — Senior Process Executive | Mar 2006 – Sep 2007
Processed loans and syndications on Loan IQ, maintaining accurate daily loan-balance reporting across multiple currencies.
Reconciled LS2 and KONDOR reports and resolved breaks in line with audit requirements. • Updated cash rates including LIBOR and STIBOR in LS2 to support accurate loan processing.
JK AGRI-GENETICS LIMITED — Accounts & Administration | Earlier Experience
Handled bookkeeping, Profit & Loss accounts, bank reconciliation, employee expenses, supplier reconciliation and audit coordination.
BANKING & DOMAIN EXPOSURE
Investment Banking | FX Settlements | Trade Processing | Reconciliations | NOSTRO Accounts | Prime Brokerage | Equity & Cash Operations | Loans & Syndications | Client Onboarding | SWIFT Confirmations / Connectivity | Banking Applications | Financial Operations
TECHNOLOGY & TOOLS
Shreedhar Rayala | Senior Business Analyst | Banking & Financial Services
JIRA | SQL | IntelliMatch | Loan IQ | LS2 | KONDOR | APIs | SFTP | SWIFT | Process Mapping | Data Flows | Application Integration | Agile / Scrum
Strong experience translating operational requirements into functional specifications and implementation-ready artefacts. • Hands-on experience with AS-IS / TO-BE process analysis, process mapping, gap analysis and process improvement. • Extensive exposure to investment banking operations, FX settlements, reconciliations and trade-related workflows. • Experienced in working with business, operations, product, architecture, development and QA stakeholders.
